dialogue: Ok, so you know how there are some springs scattered around here?
Well, maybe you already found my sign, but if you Fall Fast-ly onto a spring,
You'll bounce way further! This can help you climb up a wall way faster!
This works on all the bouncy friends you'll encounter too!
On top of this, if you slide boost into a spring,
You'll also get that same boost!
I'm not really sure how that works, but it can help you gain lotsa speed!
Ok and finally, you might've figured this out but
If you wall jump right after a spring, your speed will carry further!
There's a lot of different ways you can use springs to gain speed!
If you want some more movement tips, check back in with me!
I got loads more where that came from!
